chain.title: Zinc Learns to Lie
chain.desc: One zinc ingot on a stonecutter becomes one Copycat Block; right-click it with any material to assign and rotate that block's appearance, and a wrench pulls the material back out.

chain.title: Eight Boards, One Ingot
chain.desc: The stonecutter splits a single zinc ingot into eight thin boards, the cheapest copycat in the set and the crafting base for boxes and catwalks.

chain.title: A Crate Made of Anything
chain.desc: Six copycat boards laid in an open ring. The finished box wears whatever material you hand it, so storage can vanish into a wall.

chain.title: Gangway in Costume
chain.desc: Three copycat boards in a shallow bridge. It behaves like its non-copycat counterpart while showing the texture of any block you assign.

chain.title: Cut Into Eighths
chain.desc: Stonecutting one zinc ingot yields eight bytes, the smallest piece in the mod; several can share one block space, each holding its own material.

chain.title: Half a Face
chain.desc: Stonecut straight from zinc. Two half panels crafted side by side rebuild one of Create's own copycat panels, so the two mods feed each other.

chain.title: A Coat of Paint
chain.desc: Eight per zinc ingot on the stonecutter, or craft two Copycat Half Layers together; the layer skims a surface without eating the block behind it.

chain.title: Sixteen From One
chain.desc: The most generous cut in the mod: a single zinc ingot leaves the stonecutter as sixteen slices.

chain.title: Climbing the Facade
chain.desc: Six ladders per zinc ingot. It climbs exactly like a vanilla ladder while wearing whatever material you assign, so shafts stop looking like shafts.

chain.title: Four Hinges of Zinc
chain.desc: Four per zinc ingot on the stonecutter, and one of Create's copycat panels converts straight across into one.

chain.title: Doors That Slip Aside
chain.desc: Stonecut one per zinc ingot. It converts back and forth with the Copycat Folding Door, so you can change the motion without spending more metal.

chain.title: Redstone Under the Mask
chain.desc: An iron door plus a zinc ingot, shapeless. It keeps the iron door's redstone-only opening while disguised as any block you like.

chain.title: Solid Only to the Eye
chain.desc: Stonecut one per zinc ingot. Ghost copycats have no collision with entities, so a finished wall can be walked straight through.

notes: Verified against copycats-3.0.8+mc.1.20.1-forge.jar (Forge/NeoForge, MC 1.20.1). All 45 ids come from assets/copycats/models/item/*.json intersected with block./item. keys in assets/copycats/lang/en_us.json. PARENT ASSUMPTIONS: the chain starts after Create has given the player zinc ingots, a stonecutter, a wrench, cogwheels, large cogwheels and fluid pipes; create:copycat_panel and create:copycat_step belong to Create itself and are never quested here. Almost every copycat is a plain minecraft:stonecutting recipe from #forge:ingots/zinc, with verified yields: block 1, slope 2, trapdoor 4, ladder 6, board 8, byte 8, layer 8, pane 8, flat_pane 8, slice 16. Copycat cogwheel, large cogwheel and fluid pipe are shapeless: four of the Create original plus one zinc ingot yields four. Copycat iron door is shapeless from a vanilla iron door plus a zinc ingot. Mechanics confirmed from tooltip.copycats.characteristics.* in en_us.json: right-click with material to assign and rotate, wrench to remove material, shift-right-click empty-handed to toggle connected textures, ghost blocks have no entity collision, functional copycats have the same usage as their non-copycat counterparts, multi-state copycats allow several materials in one block space, stackable copycats enlarge when right-clicked with the same copycat. Every recipe in the jar is wrapped in forge:conditional with a copycats:feature_enabled check, so a pack that disables a feature in config removes that recipe. DROPPED by the desirability rule (present in the jar, deliberately unquested): copycat_slab, copycat_stairs, copycat_vertical_stairs, copycat_wall, copycat_fence, copycat_fence_gate, copycat_stone_button, copycat_wooden_button, copycat_stone_pressure_plate, copycat_wooden_pressure_plate, copycat_light_weighted_pressure_plate, copycat_heavy_weighted_pressure_plate. Nothing was dropped for being unverifiable.
